verdict.rationale: Loops documents that draft campaigns, content included, can be created from the API and then reviewed and sent from the dashboard. That gives an agent-draft, human-approves-before-send gate. Campaigns are described as sends to a segment, but the evidence never shows an agent setting the segment through the API, and nothing shows scheduling or a formal approval queue. missing for 10: documented API segment targeting for draft campaigns, scheduled/queued send state, formal approval workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Create draft campaigns, content and all, straight from the API. Review and send from the dashboard.
create and manage campaigns, email content, themes, and workflows
Campaigns Send to a segment of contacts one time
